title: Underfloor heating in autumn: prepare your home for the heating season
pageTitle: Prepare underfloor heating for autumn | AZGS
description: Practical tips to prepare underfloor heating for the heating season: manifold, controls, floor finish, air in the system and renovation planning in the Utrecht region.
intro: After summer, heating may still feel far away, but autumn is the right moment to check or install underfloor heating. If you wait until the first cold week, you often discover problems too late: one zone does not heat properly, the controls are set incorrectly, or the floor build-up is not ideal. A short check now helps you start the heating season comfortably.
